title: Easy Pepperoni Pizza Muffins
description: These pizza muffins are a quick and easy snack made simple by using refrigerated biscuit dough, prepared pizza sauce, pepperoni, and mozzarella.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) can refrigerated buttermilk biscuit dough
10 tablespoons pizza sauce (such as Ragu® Homestyle)
10 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese, or as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Coat a 10-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.

Press biscuits, one at a time, between hands to flatten; press each into bottom and up sides of a muffin cup. Set aside for dough to settle and slightly rise, about 5 minutes; lightly press dough into cups if needed.
Spoon 1 tablespoon pizza sauce into each cup, followed by 1 slice pepperoni, and 1 tablespoon mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned and cheese melted, about 10 minutes. Remove pizza muffins from tin; let cool on a wire rack, about 5 minutes.

video.description: Watch how to make these super easy pepperoni pizza muffins! Flattened refrigerated biscuit dough is pressed into muffin pans and par-baked for the 'crust'. Then a spoonful of pizza sauce, some shredded mozzarella cheese and a slice of pepperoni goes in. Bake these up for about 10 minutes and you've got pizza on the go!
